_about: Birth circumstances, unusual births, family structures and sibling outcomes. Placeholders: {city} {hometown} {country} {npc} {first} {hero} {villain} {company} {lab}; inline choices {a|b}. Original content written for DCUGen.

places.text: in the maternity ward of the public hospital in {hometown}
at home, with a midwife and a kitchen full of relatives
in the back seat of a {taxi|pickup truck|city bus|police cruiser} stuck in traffic
in a private clinic with a view of the river
in an emergency room during a citywide blackout
on a military base where a parent was stationed
aboard a {ferry|cargo ship|cruise liner} in open water
on a transatlantic flight, to the delight of the crew
in a refugee camp clinic run by volunteers
in a prison infirmary, where {their} mother was serving a sentence
places.secret: Was born to an incarcerated mother and has never told anyone.

places.text: in a rural farmhouse during a snowstorm that closed every road
in a tour bus parked outside a concert hall
in the lobby of a {company} office tower when the elevators stopped
in a hurricane shelter in a school gymnasium
in a commune's birthing tent, under hand-painted stars
in a hospital wing evacuated during a costumed brawl outside
in a research facility's medical bay, for reasons the paperwork never explains
in a church basement turned into a clinic after a flood
in an ambulance crossing a bridge at two in the morning
in a circus wagon between shows
in an embassy residence abroad
in a mountain cabin with no phone signal

unusual.text: A meteor shower lit up the sky over {hometown} the night {name} was born.
unusual.hook: Astronomers have noticed the same shower is due back this year.

unusual.text: Every clock in the hospital wing stopped at the moment of birth and started again a minute later.
Was born during a total solar eclipse.
Was delivered by a costumed hero who flew the mother to the hospital and never gave a name.

person.who: the masked flier called {hero} who delivered {name} as a baby
person.status: Has never been seen since, though a birthday card arrives every few years without a return address.

unusual.text: Was found as an infant in a {basket on a church step|car seat at a fire station|cardboard box behind a police precinct|blanket in a subway car} with a note that only gave a first name.
unusual.secret: Doesn't know who the birth parents were; the note is kept in a locked drawer.

unusual.text: Was conceived through an experimental fertility program at {lab}, which has since closed under a cloud.
unusual.secret: The fertility program was a front for genetic research.
unusual.hook: A researcher who once worked at {lab} wants to run a few 'follow-up' tests.

unusual.text: Was born in a lab. Officially, the mother was a volunteer test subject; unofficially, nobody will say.
unusual.secret: There are records of 'Subject {number}' that match {their} birthday.

unusual.text: Was one of a set of twins, but the other baby vanished from the nursery on the second night.
unusual.hook: Someone with {their} face has been seen in another city.

unusual.text: Weighed almost nothing at birth and was not expected to live through the week.
Was born with a birthmark shaped uncannily like {a key|a crescent|an open hand|a lightning bolt|a star chart}.
Was born during a villain attack on the city, in a hospital running on emergency generators.
A stranger in an old-fashioned coat visited the nursery, looked at the baby for a long time, and left without a word.
unusual.hook: The stranger has been seen again, unchanged after all these years.

unusual.text: Was born at the exact moment of a city-wide power surge that blew out every transformer for six blocks.
A flock of birds settled on the hospital roof and stayed until the birth was over.
Was born with eyes of two different colors, which the family considered lucky.
The delivering doctor later lost a medical license for unlicensed experimentation.
unusual.hook: The doctor kept files on every baby delivered that year.

unusual.text: Was born on the anniversary of a famous hero's death, and a newspaper ran the photo as a feel-good story.
Was switched at birth with another baby; the mistake was discovered three weeks later.
unusual.hook: The other family has never stopped wondering if the swap was really reversed.

unusual.text: Was born during an earthquake that cracked the hospital's foundation but hurt no one.
A fortune teller at a street fair told the pregnant mother that the child would 'stand between two worlds.'
Arrived three months early on the same night a spacecraft splashed down off the coast.
Was adopted out of a closed-records agency that later turned out to be run by a cult.
unusual.secret: The cult still considers {name} one of its own.

unusual.text: Never cried at birth. Doctors were worried; the nurses were unnerved by how calmly the baby watched them.
Was born in a town that was evacuated the next morning because of a chemical spill nobody ever explained.
unusual.hook: Former residents of the town are getting sick, or getting strange.

unusual.text: A mysterious benefactor paid the hospital bill in cash and left a silver {coin|ring|locket} for the child.
unusual.hook: The silver keepsake has a maker's mark matching a centuries-old smith.

unusual.text: Was born during the first sighting of a costumed hero in {city}, and the family half-jokingly treats {them} as linked.
The birth certificate lists a father nobody in the family has ever met.
unusual.secret: Has quietly been searching for the man named on the birth certificate.

unusual.text: Was born in the same hour as {their} best friend-to-be, in the same ward.
Was born with a full head of {silver|white|bright red|jet black} hair that never changed.
Was born in a storm so violent the hospital lost its roof; the newborn was found unharmed under a pile of debris.

structures.text: Was raised by both parents under one roof.
Was raised by both parents, who fought constantly but never separated.
Split time between two households after the parents divorced.

event.text: Watched {their} parents' marriage end; spent the next years shuttling between two homes.

structures.text: Was raised by a single mother who worked two jobs.
Was raised by a single father who learned to braid hair from online videos.
Was raised by grandparents after the parents could not cope.
Was raised by a grandmother whose house smelled of {cinnamon|cigarettes|church incense|motor oil}.
Was raised by an aunt and uncle who already had three kids of their own.
Was raised by an older sibling who was barely an adult.
Bounced through {three|five|seven|nine} foster homes in the system.
Grew up in a {church-run|state-run|underfunded|strict} children's home.
Was adopted as a baby by a couple who never hid it.
Was a foundling, taken in and raised by the {nun|firefighter|police sergeant|diner owner} who found {them}.
Grew up a military kid, moving bases every two or three years.
Grew up in a traveling circus family, sleeping in trailers and learning to fall before learning to read.
Was raised on a cult compound where outsiders were called 'the Unwoken'.

complication.text: Grew up inside a cult and still has relatives on the compound.

structures.text: Grew up on a back-to-the-land commune with a dozen 'parents' and no television.
Was raised mostly by boarding schools while the parents traveled.
Was raised mostly by the family's household staff.
Ran from home young and was raised, in practice, by the streets.
Was born into a crime family whose holiday dinners doubled as business meetings.

complication.text: The family name opens doors in the underworld and closes them everywhere else.

structures.text: Grew up as a diplomat's child, changing countries and languages every few years.
Spent much of childhood living at a research campus where a parent ran the lab.
Grew up on a family farm where everyone worked before school.
Grew up in a loud blended family with a stepparent and a pile of half-siblings.

moved overseas and calls twice a year
struggles with addiction and has been in and out of rehab
is a rising {politician|news anchor|tech founder|pop star} and rarely calls
married young and has three kids
vanished {five|eight|ten} years ago without a trace

died of a long illness
was killed in the crossfire of a costumed battle downtown
works as a {mechanic|line cook|warehouse supervisor|electrician} and is the best-adjusted person in the family
became a research scientist at {company}
is a struggling {actor|musician|painter|stand-up comic}
joined a religious order
is the family golden child and the comparison never stops
is the family's black sheep and proud of it
has a disability and depends on {name} for help
is a hero fan who keeps scrapbooks of every costumed rescue

is still in school and idolizes {name}
is a straight-A student with a scholarship lined up
keeps getting into fights at school
is a gaming-obsessed kid who knows every hero's stats
is quiet, watchful and sees more than anyone thinks
is a toddler who thinks {name} hung the moon
was adopted out at birth and only recently got back in touch
never forgave {name} for a falling-out years ago

only: Grew up with the full, sometimes smothering, attention of the adults.
Learned to entertain {themself} and still likes solitude.
Was treated like a small adult from an early age.
eldest: Was the built-in babysitter and still feels responsible for everyone.
Was the test case for every family rule.
Carries the weight of being the example.
middle: Learned to negotiate between everyone else's crises.
Felt invisible and learned to make noise to be noticed.
Became the family peacemaker by necessity.
youngest: Was the baby of the family and got away with more than the others.
Spent childhood trying to keep up with older siblings.
Was protected, teased and underestimated in equal measure.
twin: Has a twin and has never fully known where one ends and the other begins.
Shares a near-wordless understanding with a twin.
